rule: AGENTS.md: SAFE_MODE blocks entries; no new entry while any position is unprotected (D-11); enablement gate 2
summary: Enablement, SAFE_MODE and the unprotected-position flag are each read once, before about ten awaited REST calls (five reads, position mode, margin guard), and are not read again before the approval is consumed and the entry is sent.
expected: The three state gates hold at the moment the approval is consumed and the order is sent.
actual: They held hundreds of milliseconds to several seconds earlier. Gate 5f4 repeats only the clock-dependent checks and reuses the earlier any_unprotected value.
impact: A new entry can be sent while SAFE_MODE is on, live orders were just disabled, or a position on another symbol is unprotected. The entry is still handed to the protection coordinator. Needs such an event within seconds of a human CONFIRM.
evidence: manager.py:823 guard_placement, :841 guard_new_entries, :1015 blocks_new_entries (each occurs once in the file); awaits at :1000-1013, :1064, :1105 (margin_guard.py:342,357,393,428); recheck at :1156-1163 replaces only now_utc and the two checked-at instants, comment: 'The readings themselves are unchanged'; POST at :1337.
reproduction: Not run. Test with a fake margin guard whose evaluate enters SAFE_MODE (or disables enablement) before returning a pass: expected outcome OK with one place_entry call.
why_tests_miss: Fakes change no state during the awaits; 22-REVIEW WR-02 was fixed and tested for price age and validity only.
recommendation: Run the three synchronous guards again immediately before consume_and_record_entry_intent and refuse without consuming.

summary: The quantity is sized again at CONFIRM from freshly read equity; if it comes out one lot step above the approved quantity the whole placement is refused (QUANTITY_ABOVE_APPROVED) instead of placing the approved quantity.
expected: Quantity may be at most the approved one: placing the approved quantity when the account allows more satisfies the rule.
actual: Refused whole. On fine-step symbols an equity rise of a few tenths of a USDT between the request and the CONFIRM is enough; the CONFIRM is single use, so the plan is lost.
impact: No money risk. Trades are skipped exactly when equity ticked up since the alert: missed trades and a selection effect against the backtest/paper set; unexplained NO_TRADE rows in the Demo campaign. Frequency depends on the equity the real strategy producer sizes from (not in src/live yet).
evidence: approval_desk.py:399 approved_quantity=plan.quantity_after_rounding; live/risk_inputs.py:632-638 equity refresh at CONFIRM; manager.py:953-960; binding.py:204-222; live/signal_source.py:487-491 acknowledges the coupling. Probe output: 'equity 1000 XRPUSDT: approved 181.9, +0.55 USDT (0.055 %) -> sized 182.0: QUANTITY_ABOVE_APPROVED'; 'equity 1000 ETHUSDT: approved 0.129, +0.55 USDT (0.055 %) -> sized 0.130: QUANTITY_ABOVE_APPROVED'.
reproduction: tmp/exec_placement/probe_qty.py with PYTHONPATH = snapshot (formula of src/risk/sizing.py:45-48, real check_quantity_bound; step sizes assumed).
why_tests_miss: Tests use the same equity at issue and at placement; the smoke source was changed to do the same (plan 24-27B).
recommendation: Owner choice: place min(sized, approved), or keep the refusal and state it on the card.
known_prior: coupling noted in src/live/signal_source.py:487-491, not recorded as a risk

rule: D034 protection outranks the audit row; D-10 hand-off
summary: Between the entry POST and register_resting_entry only PersistenceError is caught; any other exception from the store write, or a cancellation of the awaiting task, skips the hand-off to protection, and nothing in the running process re-tracks a SENT row.
expected: Once the entry may exist, the hand-off to the protection coordinator happens whatever else fails.
actual: It depends on no unexpected exception class and no cancellation. No concrete trigger was found (uow.py translates the known SQLAlchemy families; the runtime drains placement tasks).
impact: A resting GTD entry the coordinator does not watch until the reconcile tick notices it or the process restarts; a fill in between gets no stop from the coordinator.
evidence: manager.py:1296-1301 except PersistenceError only; :1337 await of the POST (adapter runs it in asyncio.to_thread, binance_usdm.py:897); :1425-1445 store write precedes the hand-off; intent_recovery.py:544-551 resolver takes UNKNOWN rows only; execution_state.py:204 restorable_entries is a start-up read.
reproduction: Not run. Fake store whose record_result raises RuntimeError after a successful place_entry: register_resting_entry is not called.
recommendation: Hand off before the store write, or put the post-POST section in try/finally and shield it from cancellation.

rule: D041 (confirm token single-use, bound to user and plan hash); manager gates 0 and 1
summary: The confirm and approve tokens are never carried by a button or compared against a press; the manager's chat and token gates check a Callback that the execution service builds itself. Two docstrings are stale.
actual: The real controls are the Telegram chat id, the user allow-list, the user bound at APPROVE, the in-memory entry state and the DB consume, which are adequate for a private bot chat.
impact: None on safety; readers over-estimate what the binding gate proves.
evidence: confirm_core.py:285-287 'raw_token is held but no press carries or compares it'; mapping.py:44-55 short id = sha256(signal_id)[:32]; live/execution_service.py:223-232 Callback built from own chat id and in-memory token; intent_recovery.py:49-50 'not wired into a live process' vs src/reconcile/startup.py:56 and src/live/reconcile.py:246; confirm_recheck.py:3 names src/paper/shadow_confirm.py as the core.
recommendation: Reword D041 and the manager docstring; fix the two stale docstrings.

rule: manager docstring: the gates all run before the approval is consumed
summary: The clock-drift guard is consulted only inside place_entry, after the consume and mark_sent, so a PreSendRefusal spends the approval although nothing is sent.
expected: A condition known before sending refuses before the approval is spent.
actual: ENTRY row closed REJECTED, approval consumed, outcome ENTRY_REFUSED_BEFORE_SEND.
impact: A lost trade with a correct, fail-closed outcome.
evidence: binance_usdm.py:1362-1363 _require_signed_policy / _require_entries_allowed inside place_entry; manager.py:377-382 PreSendRefusal handling; :1390-1406 REJECTED after consume; :1588-1589 notes the first Demo rehearsal hit it.
reproduction: Not run. Drift guard that blocks entries with otherwise passing inputs.
recommendation: Expose the drift-guard verdict as a gate before the consume.
known_prior: manager.py:1588-1589 (journal added after the first Demo rehearsal)
